name: Choices That Matter
source:
Choices That Matter is a furry visual novel that tells the story of Aiden, a young adult facing a new phase in his life. The story focuses on Aiden's world as a whole, including his thoughts, actions, and of course, the extremely important choices in his life. These choices will shape his future and define how he acts. The story offers multiple paths to follow, making each playthrough and every version of Aiden you control unique. With a focus on bringing deep emotions and different perspectives to the player, we're really excited to share this demo and future updates with all of you guys!

[From [url=https://choicesthatmattervn.itch.io/choicesthatmatter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《重要的选择》是一部毛茸茸的视觉小说，讲述了艾登的故事，艾登是一个面临人生新阶段的年轻人。故事聚焦于艾登的整个世界，包括他的思想、行动，当然还有他人生中极其重要的选择。这些选择将塑造他的未来并决定他的行为方式。这个故事提供了多条可供遵循的路径，使每个游戏和你控制的艾登的每个版本都是独一无二的。我们专注于为玩家带来深刻的情感和不同的观点，我们非常高兴与大家分享这个演示和未来的更新！

[来自[url=https://choicesthatmattervn.itch.io/choicesthatmatter]Itch.io[/url]]
